get_logger_by_name: get a logger instance for a given module name using get_logger
set_log_level_verbose: set the global Mephisto log level to DEBUG or INFO using set_mephisto_log_level with verbose
set_log_level_specific: set the global Mephisto log level to a specific level like WARNING using set_mephisto_log_level
warn_once_dedup: log a warning message only once using warn_once to avoid duplicate warnings
format_loud_text: format a string with bold red ANSI colors using format_loud for terminal output
